meta.title: Condition-Based Triggering: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role and verify whether Condition-Based Triggering is absent or refused.
Repeat the Condition-Based Triggering action as a Tenant Admin and verify that it is available. The catalog has no step for this feature or for role-specific sign-in comparison.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role and verify whether Condition-Based Triggering is absent or refused.; Repeat the Condition-Based Triggering action as a Tenant Admin and verify that it is available. The catalog has no step for this feature or for role-specific sign-in comparison.

args.need: sign in as a non-Tenant Admin user and a Tenant Admin in the same tenant, test Condition-Based Triggering for approval conditions such as value or category, and verify that it is refused or absent for the non-admin but available to the Tenant Admin

steps.note: The required feature and role comparison are not represented by any catalog step.
Provides a final observable assertion after the delegated check without claiming that it verifies the RBAC behavior.
